history.name: Branding it for a client
history.description: One file, .ledger/brand.json, is the swap surface for a new client: a logo, one accent colour, and the two font families. The other four tints of the accent are derived from the hex you give it, and a ledger with no logo sets the product name as a serif wordmark on the front page. The accent cannot be green, blue or teal, because those hues already mean new and reworked in every edition, and ledger status warns when a brand picks one that collides.
history.dev_notes: src/render/brand.mjs derives accent_deep, accent_quiet, accent_mid and accent_pale in HSL; any of them can be pinned in brand.json. A logo is embedded as a data URI (PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP). .ledger/theme.css is appended last to the PDF stylesheet for a one-off nudge.
